board.wireCodec: RLE token <height><symbol>; tokens partitioned by rowCounts; height 1 on outer reels, 1-4 on inner reels 1-4

frontendLayout.meaning: last reel index; loop ColumnCount+1 yields 6 reels
frontendLayout.topRow: client overlay copies the first cell of inner reels 1-4; not extra protocol symbols

symbols.wildHelp: The Wild symbol only appears on reels 2, 3, 4 and 5. Capture had 29+33 outer-reel Wilds; generation follows the stricter help restriction and never deals Wild on outer reels or the inner top overlay.

winModel.ways: product of winning cell/block counts per consecutive reel as listed in wmkl
winModel.hardcodedStakeFactor20: frontend GameConfigData.payline_count is hardcoded 20 and only sizes ba=bs*bl*20; it is not a winning-line count

paytable.unit: multiplied by bs*bl then by max(1,rpx); index order is 3-of-kind, 4, 5, 6

cascade.rule: after a delivery with wa>0, winning symbols are removed, remaining symbols fall, vacancies refill; rwa accumulates wa; continue requesting Spin with the same bl/bs/gid until a delivery with wa=0
cascade.ss: 0 while another delivery is required in the current tumble segment; 1 on the segment-terminal delivery
cascade.continuationBetAmount: ba=0 on continuation deliveries; ba=bs*bl*20 only on the paid start
cascade.longFrame: Help Multiple Path Wild Match: silver may surround height 2-4 paying symbols on reels 2-5 excluding Wild and treasure. Winning silver transforms in place to a random gold-framed paying symbol; winning gold transforms in place to Wild (capture: 354/354 silver-win same-height gold next; 178/183 gold-win same-height Wild, 5/5 remainder were gold Pan and stayed Pan). Non-winning frames persist through tumble. Gold does not stay on Wild.

multiplier.clientPanCollect: first-seen Pan coordinate in a tumble segment sets times=2 for animation; loaclPanInfo clears on ss=1
multiplier.incrementRule: paid: rpx=max(prev, 2*Pan RLE blocks); first free page from 0 is 2+2*blocks; later free-spin starts add 2*blocks; rpx never decreases; 0 means x1

scatterFreeRounds.trigger: paid tumble segment terminal delivery (ss=1, nfsc=0) with at least 4 Scat RLE blocks
scatterFreeRounds.fsn: 10 + 2 * max(0, scatBlocks - 4); help 4 treasures = 10 free spins, each additional treasure +2; stacked Scat is one block
scatterFreeRounds.nfsc: 1 through fsn on subsequent deliveries in the same Round
scatterFreeRounds.retrigger: help: Free spins can be retriggered. Same 4-block threshold and same 10+2*(blocks-4) award on a free tumble terminal. Not observed in 38 captured free Rounds (rare, not illegal).
scatterFreeRounds.frwa: always 0 in 3382 original-http deliveries; free wins accumulate in rwa

roundEnd.historyWrite: one list row plus one detail after the complete Round terminal

integerMultiplier.verified: 238/238 positive-rwa complete Rounds are integer under rwa/(bs*bl)
